item.title: Gold, silver prices jump as US dollar weakens
item.description: MCX gold February futures jumped 1.31 per cent to Rs 1,57,484 per 10 grams around 10.45 am on an intraday basis. Meanwhile MCX silver March futures climbed 4.81 per cent to Rs 2,61,900 per kg.

item.title: ‘Working tirelessly’: PM Modi praises Eknath Shinde’s push for Maharashtra’s progress in birthday message
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday extended birthday greetings to Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde, praising his efforts and noting that he is working tirelessly to advance the state’s development.

item.title: Gujarat Police bust liquor smuggling racket, seize bottles 10,000 hidden under helmets in truck
item.description: The Ahmedabad Police have seized a large consignment of foreign liquor concealed beneath a load of helmets and arrested a truck driver during an operation in the Narol area of the city, officials said on Monday.

item.title: EAM Jaishankar calls on Seychelles President Herminie, highlights Vision MAHASAGAR
item.description: As maritime neighbours, value his support towards advancing #VisionMAHASAGAR for economic prosperity and security in the region.

item.title: Self-confidence, health, discipline key to success: PM Modi to Assam students at Pariksha Pe Charcha
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday underlined the importance of self-confidence, health and discipline while interacting with students during Pariksha Pe Charcha 2026, held onboard the historic Charideo vessel on the Brahmaputra River.

item.title: West Bengal Uses Less Than 20% of Midday Meal Budget, Shows Official Data
item.description: For the ongoing financial year of 2026-27, the total budgetary allocation for midday meals in the state was Rs 1,673.12 crore.

item.title: Hum do, Hamare Do Darjan: AIMIM’s Shaukat Ali sparks row with new slogan
item.description: AIMIM’s Uttar Pradesh president Shaukat Ali stirred controversy with a remark suggesting a new slogan on having children: 'Hum Do, Hamare Do Darjan (We two, our two dozen)'.

item.title: J&K govt collects Rs 48 crore in job application fees over two years
item.description: The UT government said that Rs 14.48 crore was collected in 2023-24 -- including Rs 7.39 crore by JKPSC and Rs 7.09 crore by JKSSB.

item.title: Bengal SIR: Uncertainty continues over extension of voter list hearing deadline
item.description: Top officials from the office of the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), West Bengal, remained at their respective offices till late at night both on Saturday and Sunday, hoping for the intimation of the extension of the deadline from the Election Commission of India (ECI)’s headquarters in New Delhi.
